inputs_in_tool_order.role: target: sole scene, geometry, count, camera, light and color authority

source_state: Wide empty tropical cove. Clear turquoise water left and foreground, white beach curving from lower right toward center, low green ridge at left, dense vegetation right, pale rounded shoreline boulders, overlapping leaning palms. Deep blue open sky, diffuse bright sun/glow at upper-left/top. No visible people, fixtures, constructed paths, text or branding. User-supplied image; origin beyond that is unknown.
consequential: Source camera and 16:9 spatial story retained
Deliberate authored pixel art across all components
Salient objects, visible counts, shape families and overlap relations retained
Upper-left light, bright water and shaded right vegetation/beach retained
No added logos, text, characters or scenery
One request and one untouched raw result
perceptually_important: Two dominant overhead leaning palm forms and smaller mid-right palm; preserve visible additional cropped/occluded foliage rather than inferring total tree count
One isolated reddish rounded foreground beach boulder
One shore boulder group with relative large-rock placement preserved; offshore low rock tips stay separate
Smooth crescent shoreline and scalloped wet/dry sand boundary
Low ridge silhouette and wide blue negative-space sky
Bright area remains diffuse/cropped near upper-left top rather than a new full sun disk
incidental_allowed_variation: Individual palm leaflets and foliage speckles
Fine water ripples, sparkle and sand grains
rendering_scale: Consistent visible pixel clusters with stepped silhouettes and compact color ramps; approximate apparent coarse-pixel scale, not a guaranteed exact native raster grid
legacy_discipline: Crafted finish, clear visual hierarchy, warm sunlit sand/stone against cool water and deep green/blue shadow, restrained natural warm accents. Preserve source palette; do not add black/gold branding or objects.
redesign_envelope: Medium change only; no additions, relocations, camera change, season/time change or architecture.
input_boundary: Dense overlapping palms and rocks obscure some boundaries, so do not invent an exact total tree/stone count. Preserve confident salient counts, main silhouettes and placements. Fine fronds and ripples necessarily simplify.
